body: Observed 2026-10-12 during VanillaTwisted technical review with Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456, macOS. Command: corvint query --task "Full technical review of architecture, security, privacy, data integrity, frontend, operations and test assurance" --limit 1. READY returned docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-05-split-indulgence-redesign.md as sole result, marked non-binding-decision, with generic npm test guidance although this consumer uses pnpm. Specialized security/storage queries similarly ranked proposed ADR-0051/0054, requiring direct guide/accepted-ADR fallback. Receipt reports mixed-worktree c7e2140 with history tip a9e90f9 and explicit omissions; no runtime completeness claim or incorrect source mutation occurred. This is confirmed retrieval friction; intended support, stale-index contribution and root cause remain unqualified. Original receipts and review context: /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted/.agent-evidence/technical-review-2026-10-12/{corvint-context,architecture-corvint,security-corvint}.json. Separate symlink omission is already V1-1272; authority-start refusal is V1-1325; sandbox descendant check failure is V1-0568. This observation returned READY, rather than the existing unsupported-query-authority refusal. Dedup searched ranking, mixed-worktree, VanillaTwisted, authority and inspected V1-0219/V1-1272/V1-1325; rank-fusion task does not qualify this consumer query profile.
title: Qualify authority-start query ranking for broad reviews in a mixed TypeScript consumer
